config.brief:
Research the COMPANY this person works for, to judge whether it fits <Company>'s ideal customer. The company is the one in the base profile (traits.company or the organization they gave us); when there is none, use the domain of their work email. A free-mail domain (gmail.com, outlook.com and the like) names no company: leave every field empty. Use public business sources only: the company's own site, its careers page and job posts, press, and business directories. Never research the individual person or anyone's private data.

Find:
1. What the company sells and to whom, in one plain sentence.
2. Its industry, from this list: <INDUSTRY OPTIONS, matching the industry output below>.
3. Its size in employees, as the band a source supports.
4. Whether it fits <Company>'s ICP: <ICP>. Answer strong, partial or no, and say why in one sentence that cites the source. Answer unknown when the sources do not settle it.

Rules: report only what a source states about this company. Leave a field empty rather than guess, and never write a sentence saying nothing was found.

outputs.label: What they sell
outputs.description: One plain sentence: what the company sells and to whom. Empty when no source says so.

outputs.label: Industry
outputs.description: The company's industry, from the list. Empty when no source says so.

outputs.label: Employees
outputs.description: The employee band a source supports. Empty when no source says so.

outputs.label: ICP fit
outputs.description: Whether the company fits the ICP in the brief.

outputs.label: Why
outputs.description: One sentence on why, citing the source.

outputs.label: Main source
outputs.description: The URL of the strongest source behind these fields.
